blindBoundary: Fresh agents receive assigned task/fixture and installed skill/recipes; prior trials, siblings and evaluators excluded. Kit is frozen until all first outputs are recorded.

acceptance.visuals: Complete supplied-fixture views, readable figures, theme defaults, no custom ordinary-UI CSS, full-width prose/cards and left control rails.
acceptance.interactions: Task controls, linked filter scopes, tabs/drafts, table sorting/page/decision state, selection, snapshots, export and training/resize work.
acceptance.robustness: All themes, light/dark, desktop/phone, empty/populated states; no page errors, unexpected remote requests or page overflow.
acceptance.firstPass: First archived packing attempt, then independent render/interactions on that HTML.
acceptance.autonomousFinal: Final author output, with every self-repair recorded separately. No parent feedback or shared-kit repair during authoring.

result: All three agents completed autonomously; frozen output behavior passed. Shared control-spacing defect was repaired after the trial and accepted repacks passed workflow and enhanced UI checks.
